St. Croix has belonged successively to the Caribs, Spanish, English, French, Dutch, Danes, and Americans. The island was discovered by Columbus on his aecmd voyage, November 14, 1493. The Earl of Cumberland reported St. Croix a wilderness. Two colonies, one of Dutch, the other of French settlers, arrived in 1625 and were joined by French refugees.
